context:
Introduce a single chart-type capability registry and derive CLI help,
--chart-type validation, MCP validation, and template parity checks from it.
Extend runtime rendering dispatch to cover all chart types currently declared
in templates using existing ASCII chart adapters and conversion helpers.

For template rendering, replace silent drop behavior with explicit skipped
reasons when a chart is inapplicable (for example, insufficient runs or
missing query data). Keep rendering resilient while making omissions visible.

For heatmap readability, standardize fixed-width cell geometry so shaded
blocks and right-aligned numerals consistently occupy the same width in each
platform column, with explicit separators retained between columns.

For query distribution output, remove series marker prefixes from labels
(for example square/diamond glyphs) when they do not encode plotted data.

Revisit template composition and add targeted templates where appropriate
(latency deep dive, regression triage, executive summary) only if backed by
implemented render paths and tests.
description:
Recent visualization enhancements introduced additional ASCII chart types,
but template and selection workflows are not fully integrated end-to-end.
Several chart types are declared in named templates yet silently skipped at
render time because chart registries and render dispatch paths are out of sync.

This follow-up aligns chart type registries, rendering support, template
composition, and recommendation logic so named templates are trustworthy and
directly selectable chart types match actual capabilities.

The implementation must also prevent silent omissions by surfacing explicit
"not applicable" reasons, and add regression tests for template/chart parity.

In addition, no-color readability regressions must be addressed in this
follow-up: query heatmap cells need consistent block widths with improved
numeric spacing, and query distribution labels must remove decorative series
marker prefixes that are not part of plotted geometry.

anti_patterns.dont: add new chart names directly in multiple modules
anti_patterns.instead: define one canonical source and import it

anti_patterns.dont: prepend decorative series glyphs to box-plot labels when glyphs are not used in the plot body
anti_patterns.why: they waste label width and add noise

anti_patterns.dont: render heatmap cells with mixed-width fill/value layouts
anti_patterns.instead: enforce fixed cell width and right-aligned numerals

anti_patterns.dont: silently skip unsupported template chart types
anti_patterns.instead: emit explicit skip reasons and test them
anti_patterns.why: users cannot trust template output completeness

anti_patterns.dont: widen comparison charts to arbitrary N-way semantics without design
anti_patterns.instead: enforce two-run expectations or provide explicit selection
anti_patterns.why: current logic is pairwise and order-sensitive

deferrals.reason: Current follow-up is scoped to ASCII chart integration and template correctness
deferrals.summary: Add non-ASCII (PNG/HTML) equivalents for new template bundles

preserves.behavior: Existing chart outputs for performance_bar, distribution_box, query_heatmap, query_histogram, cost_scatter, and time_series remain unchanged for identical inputs
No regression in no-color/no-unicode rendering behavior for comparison and summary charts
Query distribution labels remain text-first with no unused marker glyph prefixes
Query heatmap no-color rendering keeps fixed-width per-cell layout with stable column separators
benchbox visualize existing templates (default, flagship, head_to_head, trends, cost_optimization, comparison) remain valid CLI choices

verifications.description: Visualization unit tests pass for ASCII charts and no-color rendering
MCP visualization tool tests pass with updated chart registry expectations

verifications.command: uv run ruff check benchbox/core/visualization/ benchbox/cli/commands/visualize.py benchbox/mcp/tools/visualization.py tests/unit/visualization/ tests/unit/mcp/test_visualization_tools.py
verifications.description: Ruff passes on touched visualization and CLI modules

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/visualization/ascii/test_ascii_charts.py -k "heatmap or box_plot" -q
verifications.description: Heatmap and box-plot readability regressions are covered by focused tests

work_units.summary: Create canonical chart capability registry shared by templates, CLI, and MCP
Add regression tests for template-chart parity, registry consistency, skip reasons, heatmap layout, and box-plot label formatting
Run verification suite and finalize with updated TODO indexes
Implement missing render dispatch paths for template-declared chart types
Align CLI --chart-type validation/help and all/auto behavior with canonical registry
Align MCP validation and docs with canonical registry; update suggestion logic for new charts
Add explicit template skip reporting for inapplicable charts instead of silent omission
Define/enforce comparison chart input semantics (two-run enforcement or explicit selection)
Improve query heatmap no-color scanability with fixed-width cell blocks and numeral spacing
Remove non-semantic series marker prefixes from query distribution labels
Evaluate and update named templates (existing and optional new templates) based on supported chart/data fit
